dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: Whoa, that is a massive beast... This octopus looks even bigger than the Saurians back in my tribe!

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: Hey, no need to look so shocked... Wait, come to think of it, people around here probably reel in beasts this big all the time, don't they?

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: I guess someone from Natlan is the real rare sight here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh? Don't you feel cold out here?

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: A little bit, yeah! But I just did a few squats over there, so I'm feeling much better now.

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: If you're cold, just move around to get your blood pumping.

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: Next time you feel a chill, give it a shot!

dialogues.speaker: Pweza
dialogues.text: Bye... I wonder when they're gonna cook this octopus up?
